verdict.rationale: Synthesia documents a public REST API (Video, Upload, Billing and Localization APIs), an llms.txt documentation index, and an MCP server. None of the evidence mentions a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec. The llms.txt file is a documentation index, not an API specification, and the MCP server is a separate capability, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
